title: Title Page Volume 1

illustrates.quote: A wide variety of material appears in the front matter of textbooks. Use the guidelines throughout this document to determine the best format to use. (See Sample 2-21: Transcriber-Generated and Front Matter Pages on page 2-50.)

print.notes: Print original is a photographic reproduction of a real book's cover/title/copyright/contents page (references/_gemini/gold-2-A/page-094.png, page-095.png), not encoded as running text anywhere in the source .txt. Neither independent transcription run modelled it into print.blocks (both left print.blocks empty); this reconciliation viewed the page image directly to confirm the braille.lines transcription and the sample's own title/rule citation, but likewise leaves print.blocks empty -- building a faithful print.blocks model of a photographed book cover is out of this reconciliation's scope (reconciling two existing transcription runs), not a disagreement between them to resolve.

resolution: braille.lines: A and B agree on content; A's version (kept here) retains the source's own leading/internal/trailing blank braille lines verbatim (confirmed by direct re-derivation from source-lines-1390-2934.txt), matching this gold corpus's established convention (see e.g. tests/gold/bana-formats-2016/section-5's own U+2800-filler-line handling); B's version silently strips those blank lines. illustrates.quote: verified verbatim against source-lines-1390-2934.txt (A and B agreed on the rule id; B's own quote field echoed this file's title rather than quoting the rule, so is not used).

corrections.note: Addendum 2.3.6e: new required reproduction notice, "Any further reproduction or distribution other than in an accessible format is an infringement," replacing the 2016 "Further reproduction or distribution in other than a specialized format is prohibited." Confirmed by the Addendum BRF and by liblouis. The second line is exactly 40 cells.

Gold regeneration from the PDF (Fable review recommendation 1): the K33 spacing audit (gold-spacing-audit/) never checked blank-line counts, since a text dump has no way to show a wholly blank line at all. This regenerates blank-line counts from the vertical gap between the book's own SimBraille text rows either side of the gap (gap in points divided by this box's own measured single-line pitch, rounded), which is unaffected by the earlier 2-cells-collapsed-to-1 text-dump bug. 1 delete. Evidence per gap: PDF p.95: this box's first matched line is itself margin line 1 -- 0 leading blank line(s); gold had 5
